verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community hands-on report of running cua-agent 0.1.29 with the OMNI loop on a local gemma3:4b model. That suggests the agent can use non-default or self-hosted models, though the run failed for an unrelated WebSocket connection reason. None of the docs in the pack describe how to configure a custom or OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of model endpoint configuration, explicit OpenAI-compatible base-URL support, examples of other providers or endpoints, and a successful hands-on corroboration.
